Rina Desai: Heads-up 07: onboarding import queue slowed for tenants created between 02:10-02:40 UTC. Need a short customer note + enterprise escalation plan.
Tom Alvarez: I'll draft the outbound. Keep it two short paragraphs and include reindex steps + assurance.
Priya Menon: Quick workaround: `Console > Data > Re-import` or API: `POST /v1/imports/:id/retry`. Add that logs show a processing backlog, not data loss.
ops-bot: infra-bot: rollout-2025-04-14 started at 2025-04-14T02:45:12Z, progress: 5/8 nodes.
Rina Desai: Also include a goodwill gesture for affected customers and invite them to a troubleshooting office hour.
Tom Alvarez: Draft outbound: `Hi — we observed a processing delay affecting some new tenant imports created 02:10-02:40 UTC. Engineers deployed a fix and processing is underway; we expect full catch-up within ~4 hours. If you need faster access, trigger a manual re-import in the Console (Console > Data > Re-import) or call the retry API. No customer data was exposed or altered. As an apology, we'll add a one-time credit equivalent to one day's ingestion fees and invite you to a troubleshooting office hour. Reply "officehour" to join or email cs@redwood.ai for urgent help.`
Carlos Ruiz: Swap "apology" -> "courtesy credit" and include calendar link: https://cal.redwood.com/officehours.
Nina Park: I'll assemble a list of impacted renewal cohort tenants and ping their AMs for proactive outreach.
ops-bot: infra-bot: rollout-2025-04-14 update: progress: 8/8 nodes, status: success at 2025-04-14T02:50:03Z.
Priya Menon: Backlog processing rate doubled post-fix; current projection: catch-up by 06:00 UTC. I'll confirm when credits are queued.
Tom Alvarez: Sending now to Intercom for affected segment. Will drop Intercom id here and short feedback survey link after send.
Rina Desai: Owners: Tom outbound + Intercom, Nina AM flags, Priya verification of credits & ETA, Carlos enterprise email templates. Please post campaign id and final copy here when live.
Tom Alvarez: Intercom campaign created id=IC-20250414-72. Final copy posted. Feedback survey: https://tiny.redwood.com/feedback-ic72 (Yes/No).
Rina Desai: Great. Close this thread after credits posted and feedback summary. Thanks all.
